surface: SUNNYVAiLE LIBRAiRY / ChatGPT Guide chapter 1 Astra successor

readerContract.humanQuestion: I have a real job to do in ChatGPT. Where do I start, which current model and effort should I choose, and how do I know the result is right?
readerContract.promisedPayoff: The reader can distinguish Chat, Work and Codex, choose among Luna, Terra, Sol and Astra when controls exist, use an honest no-picker route, bound a higher-effort task and inspect the real result.
readerContract.priorKnowledge: No technical background, paid plan, model picker or knowledge of Astra is assumed.
readerContract.centralMentalModel: Model, effort, surface and plan are separate choices; Astra is an additional specialist engine, not a replacement for task definition, source authority, permission boundaries or inspection.
readerContract.dailyLifeConnection: A Class of 2002 reunion invitation and small website contain an old date that must not reach guests.
readerContract.surfaceJob: A friendly current reference chapter that teaches setup, model and effort choice, a complete bounded job, verification and repair.
readerContract.desiredFeeling: I understand what Astra changes, what it does not change and how to choose without assuming the newest or most expensive option is automatically best.

canonicalTruth.freshnessTrigger: Any change to ChatGPT surfaces, settings, plans or base chapter facts.
Any change to Astra, model roles, effort, plan access or picker controls.
Any change to the guide reader, Free route or book role.
Any change to official model, effort, prompt, context, permission, Skill or surface guidance.
Any change to reference-book teaching requirements.
Any change to LAiDIES public prose rules.

strengthsToUse: Answer the immediate choice before terminology.
Separate official facts, editorial guidance and account unknowns.
Give the reader a usable next move.
patternsNotToCopy: Do not turn the chapter into an FAQ.
Do not inherit dated model claims.
Do not replace the connected case with feature cards.

glossaryAccumulation.producerGuard: Introduce Astra only when the reader reaches the model decision.
glossaryAccumulation.preventionEvidence: The old-date job remains the opening and model labels answer a live choice.

templateRepetition.producerGuard: Keep one unfolding case rather than repeated model cards.
templateRepetition.preventionEvidence: The existing connected chapter remains intact.

decorativeAnalogy.producerGuard: Retain the four-part metaphor only because each part maps to a distinct control.
decorativeAnalogy.preventionEvidence: Astra changes the engine choice but not source or inspection requirements.

referenceConfetti.producerGuard: Use Rewind Era material only where it drives the source conflict or consequence.
referenceConfetti.preventionEvidence: No new decorative nostalgia is added.

missingMechanism.producerGuard: Explain why more effort can add review and when Astra-specific boundaries change behaviour.
missingMechanism.preventionEvidence: The new prose links authority, autonomy, delegation and test scope to concrete waste or stoppage.

genericAction.producerGuard: Give one copyable Astra boundary block and a no-picker route.
genericAction.preventionEvidence: The reader leaves with an actionable selection and prompting rule.

jargonBeforeMeaning.producerGuard: Explain the job shape before naming Astra or effort labels.
jargonBeforeMeaning.preventionEvidence: Each model row begins with an ordinary task pattern.

disconnectedSystem.producerGuard: Keep model, effort, surface, plan, sources and checks connected to the same reunion job.
disconnectedSystem.preventionEvidence: The revised selection explicitly returns to the case.

joylessInstruction.producerGuard: Retain warm direct narration and the earned tiara line.
joylessInstruction.preventionEvidence: The humour lands only after the effort mechanism is clear.

purposeTooNarrow.producerGuard: Use the reunion as a transfer method, not the purpose of ChatGPT.
purposeTooNarrow.preventionEvidence: The unchanged neighbourhood transfer case remains.

mechanismBeforeMotivation.producerGuard: Do not move the model taxonomy ahead of the wrong-date consequence.

workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.producerGuard: Keep current model guidance visibly transferable beyond the reunion.
workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.preventionEvidence: The Astra example uses a distinct larger workload and the close states the general habit.

technicalExplainerVoice.producerGuard: Translate every current control into a practical decision.
technicalExplainerVoice.preventionEvidence: No API syntax appears except in a clearly separated confusion warning.

draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: Use the provided model if there is no picker; otherwise start with the lowest-cost model and effort likely to finish the job, reserving Astra for work whose synthesis, context or tools can materially benefit.
causalSequence: The old date establishes why the result matters.
The required output determines the working surface.
The job shape determines model and effort.
Astra-specific boundaries prevent unnecessary stopping, delegation gaps and excess testing.
Inspection and targeted repair remain the final authority.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: The three-source Class of 2002 reunion correction remains a Terra/Medium-sized job rather than being inflated to justify Astra.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: A larger cross-system event launch with contradictory records, multiple outputs and tools demonstrates when Astra may earn its cost.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Choose one permitted job, name its authority and finish line, use the lowest model/effort that plausibly fits and add Astra-specific autonomy, delegation and testing boundaries only when using Astra for a larger job.

analogyPlan.concept: Model, effort, surface and plan are distinct.
analogyPlan.analogy: The model is the engine, effort is how long it may work, the surface is the workshop and the plan is the allowance.
analogyPlan.mapping: Astra adds a specialist engine; the other three controls retain their jobs.
analogyPlan.limit: No engine, time, workshop or allowance predicts correctness.
analogyPlan.whyItHelps: It prevents Astra and higher effort from collapsing into one vague idea of better AI.

humourPlan.lessonJob: High effort is a setting, not a tiara punctures status-seeking after the task-fit mechanism is understood.

draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: Preserve the conversational opening, setup, four-choice mental model, current model/effort guide, complete case, inspection, repair, Free/paid boundary, transfer challenge and dated sources.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: Revise the connected narrative in place; do not append an Astra feature box that reads like a release note.

communicationDesign.surfaceAdaptation: Make the invisible trade among task shape, effort, access and agent behaviour visible inside one practical choice.

humanQuestion.reason: The reader wants to know whether she should choose Astra.
humanQuestion.plannedEvidence: Answer with a job-fit rule and no-picker route.

usefulCuriosity.reason: The newest model can still be the wrong tool for a small job.
usefulCuriosity.plannedEvidence: Keep the reunion case on Terra/Medium.

invisibleProcessConcrete.reason: Effort and agent behaviour are otherwise hidden.
invisibleProcessConcrete.plannedEvidence: Connect extra reasoning to review, stopping, delegation and testing consequences.

familiarTechnicalMovement.reason: Model labels must follow an ordinary job distinction.
familiarTechnicalMovement.plannedEvidence: Move from extract, everyday synthesis, demanding professional work and cross-domain agent work to model names.

limitationsConsequences.reason: Account access and more reasoning do not guarantee a correct artifact.
limitationsConsequences.plannedEvidence: Preserve conditional access and inspection language.

humourSurprise.reason: The tiara line helps detach effort from prestige.
humourSurprise.plannedEvidence: Keep it after the full effort explanation.

betterNextQuestion.reason: The reader needs a reason to move up rather than a ranking.
betterNextQuestion.plannedEvidence: Ask what the lower route missed and whether deeper synthesis would change the outcome.

explanationArc.adaptation: Answer the picker question directly, then show why the reunion job stays modest and what a genuinely Astra-shaped job adds.

representativeProofPlan.highestRisk: A current chapter could present Astra as universally best, promise unavailable controls or confuse ChatGPT effort with the API.
representativeProofPlan.plannedProof: Revise only the model, effort and source sections; preserve the complete case and verify every Astra claim against the two dated source cards.
representativeProofPlan.acceptanceOutcome: A newcomer can explain why the reunion case does not need Astra, identify one job that might, and use a complete no-picker route.
